title: Heading of the panel that lists a room's people and socios (AI agents).
description: Line under the heading. _admin: the reader is a room admin. _archived: the room is archived. _off: Rooms are off in Settings.
people: Section heading; `n` is how many people are in the room.
people-list: Accessible name of the list of people.
invited: Section heading; `n` is how many invitations wait.
invited-list: Accessible name of the list of invited people.
invite-someone: Section heading in the Members panel over the form that invites a person to the room.
socios: Section heading: the room's AI agents. "socio" is a product noun.
usage: Section heading: the room's cost and limits.
leave: Button at the bottom of the Members panel: opens the dialog to leave the room.
day: A short date (month and day); `at` is the date.
member.you: After the reader's own name in the list, in parentheses.
member.invited: Under an invited person's name: they haven't joined yet.
member.invited-until: Under an invited person's name; <date></date> becomes the short date the invite expires (keep the tags).
member.role.admin: Under a member's name: they are a room admin.
member.role.member: Under a member's name: an ordinary member, not a room admin.
member.options: Accessible name of the ⋯ button beside a person; `name` is theirs.
member.make-admin: Item in a person's ⋯ menu: gives them the room admin role.
member.role-failed: Toast when giving a person the room admin role, or taking it away, failed in the room's Members panel (shown when the server gives no reason).
member.step-down: Menu item: the reader gives up their own admin role.
member.make-member: Item in a person's ⋯ menu: takes away their room admin role.
member.not-admin: Toast; `name` is the person. _you: the reader stepped down.
member.take-back: Menu item that cancels a pending invitation.
member.remove: Item in a person's ⋯ menu: removes them from the room.
member.taken-back: Toast; `name` is the person whose invite was canceled.
member.remove-failed: Toast when removing a person from the room (or canceling their invitation) failed in the Members panel (shown when the server gives no reason).
invite.list-failed: Error in the Members panel's invite form when the list of workspace people who can be invited couldn't be loaded.
invite.loading: In the invite form while the list of people loads.
invite.everyone: Shown when nobody is left to invite. "Socio" is the product name.
invite.failed: Toast when sending an invitation from the Members panel's invite form failed (shown when the server gives no reason).
invite.person: Label of the picker of the person to invite.
invite.role: Label of the picker of the invited person's role (admin or member).
invite.busy: The Invite button's label while it sends.
invite.note: Note under the invite form in the Members panel: an invitation expires after 7 days, and before joining the person is told they will see the room's whole message history.
socio.list: Accessible name of the list of the room's socios (AI agents).
socio.status.active: Under a socio's name: it answers messages here.
socio.status.requested: Under a socio's name: a room admin asked for it, a workspace admin must approve.
socio.status.withdrawn: Under a socio's name: a workspace admin took it out of the room.
socio.status.removed: Under a socio's name: a room admin removed it from the room.
socio.lead: Badge on the socio that answers by default.
socio.let-in: Button for a workspace admin: approves a requested socio.
socio.let-in-failed: Toast when a workspace admin's Let in (approving a requested socio, an AI agent, for the room) failed in the Members panel.
socio.make-lead: Button: this socio becomes the room's default answerer.
socio.lead-failed: Toast when making a socio (AI agent) the room's lead, its default answerer, failed in the Members panel.
socio.remove: Button for a room admin beside a socio that isn't the lead: removes it from the room.
socio.remove-label: Accessible name of Remove; `name` is the socio.
socio.remove-failed: Toast when a room admin's Remove on a socio (AI agent) in the Members panel failed.
socio.take-out: Button for a workspace admin: withdraws a socio from the room.
socio.take-out-label: Accessible name of Take out; `name` is the socio.
socio.taken-out: Toast; `name` is the socio. _lead: it was the lead, so nobody answers until another leads.
socio.take-out-failed: Toast when a workspace admin's Take out (withdrawing a socio, an AI agent, from the room) failed in the Members panel.
socio.asked: Toast; `name` is the socio asked for.
socio.ask-failed: Toast when a room admin's request for a company socio (AI agent) to join the room failed in the Members panel.
handoffs.saved: Toast after the room's handoff limit (how many times socios may pass one message's work to each other) was saved.
handoffs.save-failed: Toast when the room's handoff limit couldn't be saved in the Members panel. A handoff is one socio passing a message's work to another.
socio.ask-label: Label of the picker of company socios a room admin may ask for.
socio.ask: Button for a room admin: asks a workspace admin to let the chosen company socio into the room.
handoffs.none: Shown when socios in this room may not pass work to each other.
handoffs.up-to: How many times one message's work may move between the room's socios.
handoffs.label: Label of the picker for that limit. A handoff is one socio passing a message's work to another.
handoffs.workspace: The picker's first choice: the workspace's limit, `n`.
handoffs.note: Hint under the handoff limit picker in the Members panel: the limit is how many times one message's work may pass between the room's socios (AI agents); a room can set it lower than the workspace's limit, never higher.
